tools.name: diagnose_crash
tools.description: Find the mod most likely behind a modded Minecraft crash (Fabric, NeoForge, Forge). Pass the whole crash report (crash-reports/*.txt) or logs/latest.log as text. Returns the crash kind, the suspect mods ranked with reasons, how sure it is, and a fix guide. The text is read and dropped, not stored.

tools.name: mod_lab_runs
tools.description: Real runs of a Minecraft mod in the Modkeel lab: the Minecraft versions where it ran on a server or client, or crashed, and the mods it ran with. By mod id (e.g. sodium, create), not display name.

tools.name: mod_pair
tools.description: Whether two Minecraft mods ran together in the Modkeel lab, clashed, or were never tested together. By mod id.
